definition.name: SoS_cone
definition.definition: The cone of sums of Hermitian squares SoS(d) is defined as SoS(d) := cone({X tensor X : X in C^{d x d} is Hermitian}), where cone(S) = {sum_i c_i s_i : c_i >= 0, s_i in S} is the conical hull. An element M in SoS(d) can be written as M = sum_i c_i (X_i tensor X_i) for Hermitian matrices X_i and nonneg coefficients c_i. Key property (Proposition 2.1): SoS is preserved under partial trace — if M_{A1 B1 A2 B2} in SoS(D) with D=dr, then tr_{B1 B2}(M) in SoS(d). This is the 'lower-order term' in the GPS moment formulas.
